December, 2023
Author: Vivek Kumar Birla

Bench: Vivek Kumar Birla
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:236208-Db

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Petitioner :- Sanjay Srivastava,Vikas Deep Verma
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Santosh Kumar Srivastava
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Birla,J.
Hon'ble Vinod Diwakar,J.
1.

Heard Shri Sanjay Srivastava, learned counsel for the petitioners, Shri Santosh Kumar Srivastava,
learned counsel for the informant and Shri G.P. Singh, learned A.G.A. for the State respondents.
2. The present writ petition has been preferred with the prayer to quash the impugned First Information Report dated 17.03.2023 registered as Case Crime No. 0013 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 323, 506, 406 IPC and Section 3/4D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Gorakhpur and for a direction to the respondents not to arrest the petitioners in pursuance of impugned First Dr Tushar Dutt And 7 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 13 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173295265/
1 Information Report.
3.

entities.text: First Dr Tushar Dutt And 7 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Vide order dated 29.05.2023 the matter was referred to Mediation and Conciliation Centre,
Allahabad for settling the dispute amicably.
As per mediation report dated 29.08.2023 proceedings for mediation have taken place on several dates, however, no agreement was reached and mediation was failed.
Therefore, we proceed to hear the matter on merits.

4. Although prayer for quashing of FIR has been made but without insisting on the same only submission is that all alleged offences are punishable with imprisonment upto seven years, therefore the police authorities are bound to follow the procedure laid down under Section 41-A Cr.P.C.
The petitioners have been wrongly implicated and could not be arrested.

Reliance has been placed on the judgement of Apex Court in Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar, (2014) 8 SCC 273 and Social Action Forum for Manav Adhikar Vs. Union of India, Ministry of Law and Justice and others in Writ Petition (Civil) No. 73 of 2015 with Criminal Appeal No. 1265 of 2017, Writ Petition (Criminal) No.
156 of 2017, Satendra Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and Another, (2022) 10 SCC 51 and co-ordinate Division Bench of this Court in Vimal Kumar & 3 others Vs. State of U.P. & 3 others in 2021 (2) ACR 1147.
5.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Vimal Kumar & 3 others Vs. State of U.P. & 3 others in 2021 (2) ACR 1147
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
We have gone through the impugned first information report and without interfering in the same,
we are of the opinion that the guidelines framed by the Apex Court in the above noted judgement are equally applicable to the facts of the instant case.
6. Accordingly, the instant petition also stands disposed of in terms of the judgements as noted above.

Order Date :- 13.12.2023 Nitendra  Dr Tushar Dutt And 7 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 13 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173295265/
